helper.BuySettingsIntro2:
Fixed buy: 

Fixed buy means that no matter how much the target address buys, each time you follow the order, you will buy according to the set fixed amount. 

Example: If the user sets a fixed buy-in of 10 SOL. 
If the copy address buys 5 SOL, the user will follow the order and buy 10 SOL; 
if the target copy address buys 20 SOL, the user will still follow the order and buy 10 SOL.
helper.FollowAmountIntro2: When the purchase amount of the target copy address >= the minimum copy amount, the copy purchase will be executed. Prevent the copying wallet from making frequent small purchases, causing you to make frequent copying purchases.
helper.minBurnPool: The copy-buy order is triggered only when the token burn ratio is ≥ the configured value.
helper.MinBurnPoolIntro1: Only when the token destruction ratio >= the set value, copy buying will be executed.
helper.SellSettingsIntro1:
Automatic follow-up selling: 

When the copying address sells tokens, the tokens purchased by the copying order will be sold in equal proportion according to the proportion of the position sold. Note that this is only for the position of the selling copying order. If you also buy the token yourself, the tokens you bought will not be sold. 

For example: The user's copying address A buys Doge. When address A sells 10% of its own Doge position, the user's copying address A's purchased Doge position will sell 10% in equal proportion.
helper.SellSettingsIntro2:
Do not follow the sale: 

The system will not automatically help you sell the tokens, and you need to sell the tokens manually.
helper.SellSettingsIntro3:
Customized take profit and stop loss on: 

After the automatic take profit and stop loss is turned on, when the copy wallet sells, the system will not perform the selling operation, but will sell according to the take profit and stop loss parameters you set.
helper.SingleAddPositionCountIntro1: The maximum number of positions for the same token under position conditions (the number will be restored after liquidation)
helper.SingleAddPositionCountIntro2: Enter 0: It means that after copying the order, the same token will not be purchased again (after clearing and selling, it will be purchased again)
helper.SingleAddPositionCountIntro3: Input 1: means that after copying the order, the same token can be added to the position and bought once (that is, up to 2 times of copying. After clearing the position and selling, the number of times will be restored)
helper.TrailingStopLossIntro:
The stop-loss price maintains a fixed ratio to the highest price and rises as the token price rises, aiming to protect profits. 
Scenario description: Assume that the buying price is $100 and the stop-loss ratio is set to 10%; if the price drops to $90 (a 10% drop), the stop-loss sell will be triggered; if the price rises to $150, the stop-loss price will be automatically adjusted to $135 (a fixed ratio of 10% from the highest point is maintained)

tooltip.buySetting:
Max Follow Buy : Max Follow Buy refers to the maximum amount of SOL a user is willing to spend when following a trade. If the target address buys more than the maximum, the user buys the maximum; if the target buys less than or equal to the maximum, the user buys the same amount as the target. Example: If the user sets max buy to 10 SOL. If the target buys 5 SOL, the user buys 5 SOL; if the target buys 20 SOL, the user buys 10 SOL.

Fixed Buy : Fixed Buy means that regardless of how much the target address buys, the user will always buy the fixed amount set. Example: If the user sets fixed buy to 10 SOL. If the target buys 5 SOL, the user still buys 10 SOL; if the target buys 20 SOL, the user still buys 10 SOL.
tooltip.sellSetting:
Auto Follow-Sell: When the followed address sells tokens, your wallet will sell the same proportion of tokens bought via copy trade. Note: this only applies to followed positions; tokens you bought manually will not be sold.
Example: If followed address A buys Doge, and then sells 10% of its Doge holdings, your wallet will also sell 10% of the Doge purchased via copy trade.
No Follow-Sell: The system will not sell automatically; you need to sell manually.
Custom Take-Profit/Stop-Loss On: When auto TP/SL is enabled, the system will not sell automatically when the followed wallet sells, but will sell according to your configured TP/SL parameters.

buySettings.intro:
Maximum Follow Buy: Maximum Follow Buy refers to the maximum amount (up to N SOL) the user is willing to spend for a copy trade. If the target address's buy-in amount is greater than the maximum follow buy amount, the copy trade will be executed with the maximum follow buy amount. If the target address's buy-in amount is less than or equal to the maximum follow buy amount, the copy trade will be executed with the target address's buy-in amount.
Example: If the user sets the Maximum Follow Buy at 10 SOL.
* If the target address buys 5 SOL, the user will copy buy 5 SOL.
* If the target address buys 20 SOL, the user will copy buy 10 SOL.

Fixed Buy: Fixed Buy means that regardless of the amount the target copy-trade address buys, the copy trade will be executed with the set fixed quantity every time.
Example: If the user sets the Fixed Buy at 10 SOL.
* If the target address buys 5 SOL, the user will copy buy 10 SOL.
* If the target address buys 20 SOL, the user will still copy buy 10 SOL.
buySettings.intro2:
Fixed buy: 

Fixed buy means that no matter how much the target address buys, each time you follow the order, you will buy according to the set fixed amount. 

Example: If the user sets a fixed buy-in of 10 SOL. 
If the copy address buys 5 SOL, the user will follow the order and buy 10 SOL; 
if the target copy address buys 20 SOL, the user will still follow the order and buy 10 SOL.

copyTrade.intro2: When the purchase amount of the target copy address >= the minimum copy amount, the copy purchase will be executed. Prevent the copying wallet from making frequent small purchases, causing you to make frequent copying purchases.

followAmount.intro2: When the purchase amount of the target copy address >= the minimum copy amount, the copy purchase will be executed. Prevent the copying wallet from making frequent small purchases, causing you to make frequent copying purchases.

minBurnPool.intro1: Only when the token destruction ratio >= the set value, copy buying will be executed.
minBurnPool.intro2: When the purchase amount of the target copy address >= the minimum copy amount, the copy purchase will be executed. Prevent the copying wallet from making frequent small purchases, causing you to make frequent copying purchases.

sellSettings.intro:
Auto Follow Sell: When the target copy-trade address sells a token, the system will sell a corresponding proportion of the tokens that were copy-bought, based on the percentage of the position sold by the target address. Note: This only applies to the copy-bought position; if you bought the token yourself, your personally bought tokens will not be sold.
* Example: Address A, which the user is copying, bought Doge. When Address A sells 10% of its holdings of Doge, the user's copy-bought Doge position will sell a corresponding 10%.

Do Not Follow Sell: The system will not automatically sell the tokens for you; you will need to sell the tokens manually.

Enable Custom Take Profit/Stop Loss: After enabling automatic Take Profit/Stop Loss, when the copy-trade wallet reaches a sell point, the system will not execute the target address's sell operation. Instead, it will sell according to the Take Profit and Stop Loss parameters you have set.
sellSettings.intro1:
Automatic follow-up selling: 

When the copying address sells tokens, the tokens purchased by the copying order will be sold in equal proportion according to the proportion of the position sold. Note that this is only for the position of the selling copying order. If you also buy the token yourself, the tokens you bought will not be sold. 

For example: The user's copying address A buys Doge. When address A sells 10% of its own Doge position, the user's copying address A's purchased Doge position will sell 10% in equal proportion.
sellSettings.intro2:
Do not follow the sale: 

The system will not automatically help you sell the tokens, and you need to sell the tokens manually.
sellSettings.intro3:
Customized take profit and stop loss on: 

After the automatic take profit and stop loss is turned on, when the copy wallet sells, the system will not perform the selling operation, but will sell according to the take profit and stop loss parameters you set.

singleAddPositionCount.intro1: The maximum number of positions for the same token under position conditions (the number will be restored after liquidation)
singleAddPositionCount.intro2: Enter 0: It means that after copying the order, the same token will not be purchased again (after clearing and selling, it will be purchased again)
singleAddPositionCount.intro3: Input 1: means that after copying the order, the same token can be added to the position and bought once (that is, up to 2 times of copying. After clearing the position and selling, the number of times will be restored)

trailingStopLoss.intro:
The stop-loss price maintains a fixed ratio to the highest price and rises as the token price rises, aiming to protect profits. 
Scenario description: Assume that the buying price is $100 and the stop-loss ratio is set to 10%; if the price drops to $90 (a 10% drop), the stop-loss sell will be triggered; if the price rises to $150, the stop-loss price will be automatically adjusted to $135 (a fixed ratio of 10% from the highest point is maintained)

faq.airdropRelationAnswer: Yes, higher points indirectly mean greater airdrop opportunities and weight. The points system is designed to encourage long-term participation to achieve higher multipliers and rewards.
faq.howToEarnAnswer: Points are calculated by accumulating multiple dimensions, including trading points, holding points, fund points, referral points, and community activity points.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.tradingPointAnswer: Trading points are based on the basic formula: Trading Points = Trading Volume (USD) × Sector Coefficient × Quality Coefficient. The sector coefficient is adjusted according to transaction fees (e.g., Meme = 1.0, Futures = 0.1, U.S. Stocks = 0.5), and the quality coefficient depends on the profit/loss margin of each trade (e.g., 0.5%–2% = 1.0, >10% reverts to 1.0).
faq.whatIsPointAnswer: Points are an incentive mechanism on the XBIT platform, rewarding users for trading in meme, futures, and U.S. stock markets, as well as for holding positions, maintaining funds, referring others, and participating in community activities. Points can be used to join seasonal leaderboards (top 100 share the prize pool), encouraging long-term and genuine participation. The system is designed to be simple, transparent, anti-fraud, and balanced through seasonal rules and multiplier bonuses.
